gates.incremental: Use canonical ci_plan.dispatch_policy.incremental_validation and invalidation_matrix; exact changed specs plus transitive consumers, one dispatcher.

gates.final: Canonical same-C gates remain; this work order cannot declare GLOBAL_RELEASE.
gates.typecheck_command: bun typecheck in each named package directory through the authorized compiler-only executor; never tsc directly.

stop: Unknown field, action, error, permission, route, export or schema => BLOCKED_CONTRACT for that output; publish exact question and source evidence; finish other independent authorized outputs.
Producer changed since locked family pin => BLOCKED_DRIFT for affected consumers; never silently rebase semantics or widen validation.
Required path outside owns or active foreign lease => BLOCKED_OWNER; provide complete inert patch to I00/current owner.
Live service absent => ARTIFACT_READY plus BLOCKED_INTEGRATION/QUALIFICATION; no stub, permissive substitute or synthetic receipt in production.
A failing unchanged input must not be rerun until causal change or a documented transient infrastructure cause is established.
No full-suite dispatch, merge, deploy, Azure, auth policy, financial rule or producer-engine change from this work order.

handoff.format: Canonical executor receipt plus protocol fields; source commit/tree, exact path/blob preimages/postimages, contracts digests, exports, tests not run/run evidence, blockers, consumer list, lease terminal.
handoff.slot_release: ARTIFACT_READY may be per named incremental output. After receipt and explicit owner handoff, release slot; next actor needs new bounded lease. No idle wait and no inferred expiry.
handoff.shared_changes: Exact proposed diff with preimage/postimage; I00 applies only after current owner release, without rewriting the author output.
